falsifier: a date-line hop over the 1st that skips or doubles a monthly settlement
source: EC-STK-25. The case was first written as 'LA 2026-09-30, landing in Sydney 2026-10-02', but LA -> Sydney is a 17-hour hop: it advances the civil date by exactly one, so under the CORRECTED INV-DAY-03 nothing is unlived and 2026-10-01 is lived-and-missed. A date must be jumped over by more than 24 hours of offset change to be unlived at all, so the fixture uses the transition that really does it (Pacific/Midway -11 -> Pacific/Kiritimati +14, 25 hours) and ALSO keeps the original LA -> Sydney stamps as the lived-and-missed control.
mustNotBe: two settlements for one month, a missing October settlement, a freeze spent on the unlived date, or an `unlived` disposition derived from a transition that only advanced the date by one
